about_h2: About Coy's Tree Service & Odd Jobs
about_p1: We handle tree service for homes and businesses around Newport.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers storm damage and emergency removal, climbing and sectional dismantling, crane and bucket work. We work out of Newport and the towns around it.

reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: Walter O'Berry
reviews.text: I called Coys because we had a few tree limbs that were starting to touch our roof and with hurricane Erin coming our way I started to get a little worried. I didn’t want those limbs to cause more damage to our roof. Jeremy got us in between jobs quick! I called on a Monday and he was here with his guys on Wednesday. They did a great job. My wife said his guys were very nice and they cleaned up everything before they left. They charged a fair price too. And I’m not worried anymore about the hurricane. Thanks guys. I have you on my vendor list..

reviews.author: Leslie C
reviews.text: Coys tree service is wonderful did a really good job. They are quick and very clean when they finish if you need a tree cut down they are the ones to get up with thankyou guys GREAT JOB!!!

reviews.author: Ryan Bright
reviews.text: I would like to express my sincere appreciation for the outstanding service I recently received. The team demonstrated remarkable skill and efficiency throughout the entire process. They handled the removal with great care and ensured the area was left impeccably clean. I am truly impressed with the professionalism and quality of work. It was a job exceptionally well done.

reviews.author: Rick Disney
reviews.text: Great local crew that arrived early! A 3-man crew transplanted several large juniper trees and hedges on our property. A Marine Vet foreman was very knowledgeable, hustled all day long, and actually listened to our precise requests! They also later delivered multiple 25 ft Sable palms and planted them exactly on target. The crew didn't crack any cement pavers, cause any damage, or even disrupt low voltage lines, while lifting these huge trees into place. They cleaned up and made it look better than when they arrived. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Laura Welborn
reviews.text: The guys showed up on time and did a great job trimming an 80-100 yr old sweet gum tree so I don’t have to worry about it crashing into my house in a storm. They were extremely respectful of my property, and did a great job cleaning up all the debris. Would highly recommend the Coys to do any tree work!

reviews.author: James Abernathy
reviews.text: Crew took care of 8 trees in Atlantic NC. Excellent service! These guys were great and I highly recommend. We will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Sarah Vetrano
reviews.text: If you need tree removal Coy’s Tree Service is the company to call. They have removed several trees for us. Very professional, timely and friendly. The didn’t leave behind any mess for us to clean up. Their rates are great. Wonderful local company. Highly recommend. They also provide firewood, at very reasonable prices. They kept my Aunt stocked with nice seasoned fire wood over the winter, the good stuff that burns nice.

reviews.author: Noel Belcher
reviews.text: They pruned a huge live oak for me and did an excellent job. The site was clean and all debris were hauled off. Thanks!!!!!!

reviews.author: Josiah Dudley
reviews.text: We had a few dangerous trees that we needed cut on our property. Coy’s came out to give us a quote and finished the project within a few days just as we had a storm approaching. The crew was mindful of our chickens and showed patience and kindness to our autistic son. Very knowledgeable and friendly. They even invited us to church!! They are more than a tree service, they are local community members who pour back into our community!!

reviews.author: Howard Wilkerson
reviews.text: I contacted Coy’s after initially getting a prompt response. After the agreed fee, his crew came the very next day. They did a fantastic job removing 3 trees and cleaned up thoroughly. I would highly recommend their service. Great job!

reviews.author: sgp
reviews.text: After some years of benign neglect, I decided to renew my property of plantings and trees and start fresh. Cutback and clean up was my aim. After a year of searching for the right person, a close friend recommended Jeremy Coy. After a walk around, Jeremy pointed out most of the problems and fixes I was thinking about and a number of others he suggested be done. He gave me a very fair estimate and after a week, he and his crew were back to give the property the cutting, trimming and cleaning and the breathing room it was missing. He and his team were professional and helpful and the final result was Outstanding!

reviews.author: Glenn Howell
reviews.text: Jeremy and his team are outstanding in their service. No job is too big or too little. They enjoy helping others and their prices are very reasonable. Very knowledgeable and thorough, leaving the worksite cleaner than they found it. Jeremy is trustworthy and honest and he will try his best to satisfy the customer. I’ve worked in the plant/green industry for almost 50 years, I trust Jeremy to do what is best for my trees.

reviews.author: Annette Mitchum
reviews.text: The crew of Coy's Tree Service and Odd Jobs did an amazing job for us. We had 10 trees removed and 5 others trimmed. We also added a large area of underbrush the last minute and tearing down a small storage building. No problem. Hardest working crew I have seen in years. They raked up small debris, leaf blew concrete areas and walkways and hauled off trees. Great price. Will definitely use them again and highly recommend them. Wish I had thought to take photos of before and after.

reviews.author: Sheila Hemby
reviews.text: We have used Coy's Tree Service 3 times and will be using them again. They are great! They show up on time, do exactly what they say they will do, clean up the mess, not overcharge, and are professional and extremely nice. I highly recommend them for any tree removal projects.

reviews.author: Nikki Collier
reviews.text: You guys did an awesome job trimming up the tree branches hanging onto our roof, as well as removing the unstable parts of a couple of our dead trees. I’ll definitely call for your service again for any future work we need done. Bonus points for being cool to chat with. Thanks so much :)

reviews.author: Carol Neglic
reviews.text: We needed two large limbs removed which was not a large job. They were very professional and efficient. When they were done everything was cleaned up thoroughly. Reasonably prices. Will definitely call them again when needed. We highly recommend their services

reviews.author: Sandy Smith
reviews.text: Thank you Coy's Tree Service for quickly coming to our rescue! We hired another tree service to take out a dead pine. A week later, they had still not returned to remove the logs and debris. I called Coy's and they came the next day and did an excellent clean up for a reasonable price. We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Amber Patterson
reviews.text: Jeremy Coy and his workers are fantastic. Not only did they show up when they said they would...but did an outstanding job! They worked all day in the hot humid sun at our farm with a good attitude....and his price was extremely reasonable for all the work they did. I would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Judith R. Bell
reviews.text: From the first phone call and text this company was nothing short of amazing. They took my info came and gave an estimate and did the tree service all within 2 days. They hauled off the limbs and I couldn't be happier with the service I received. I highly recommend them. Thank you for such outstanding service

reviews.author: DOROTHY GRAVEL
reviews.text: Jeremy's professionalism is stellar. He immediately returned my call and was able complete the work in under 4 hours - 8 days later. As I wasn't able to be there, he sent before and after pictures along with text messages as the work progressed. His fee was more than reasonable. I highly recommend Coy's Tree Service and would use them again.

reviews.author: M.B. Naset
reviews.text: We had had some site work done on a property several years ago, resulting in some root damage to our trees. That and a storm or two made us concerned about dead limbs falling on the house. I contacted several tree companies to get estimates for this work. Coy's was one, Coy's got the job because I was VERY impressed with their professionalism, communication, work ethic and ultimately the quality of the end result. Jeremy kept in contact with me by calling me when he was onsite for the estimate, when he went to check on the crew's status, enabling me to be informed of the progress. I went to the property when he said they'd be finishing and was pleasantly surprised by the cleanup that was done. The son Erin was on site working, we walked the property and I pointed out a few branches that I wanted cut or had gotten missed. They willingly and cheerfully cut those out and took them away. I wouldn't hesitate to hire them again. Quality job ! Thank you Coy's Tree Service

reviews.author: J. Gault
reviews.text: These guys do a great job. They trimmed 3 large Live Oaks and 3 large Bradford Pear Trees. Good efficient work. Trees look super and the price was very fair. They cleaned up very good and made sure I was satisfied with the job. I highly recommend them. I'll use them for any future work I need.

reviews.author: Wild Zebra
reviews.text: Had a very large old growth pine that had a slight lean toward our home. I contacted several companies and received a couple of quotes but most were too high or I never received a call back from others. I had a colleague recommend Coy's Tree Service and their quote was the most reasonable for the scope of work performed. They did a nice clean up after the removal and I highly recommend Coy's for any tree removal services.

reviews.author: Judi Belle
reviews.text: Coy's Tree Service came out after a storm split some large branches on my pear tree. They took down the split limbs and the ones around it that had been hit. They cleaned up all the debris and were done very quickly. Reasonably priced as well. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sylvia Rola
reviews.text: Just used Coys Tree Service to take down 5 massive pine trees that were in not so great locations! They showed up on time, worked hard and got the job done very quickly. They cleaned up the area and stacked the logs very professionally. 10/10 would recommend to anyone looking for a tree service

reviews.author: Brian Ross
reviews.text: We really appreciated Coy's Tree Service. We had multiple trees that were threatening our home. Some were already dead. They were professional, courteous and did significantly more that we had initially agreed. When they found more dead trees they dropped and removed them at no extra charge. They even had the live trees removed whole and sent to the lumber yard. Good stuff. Also, we had some mail order items arrive when we were not there. They secured the items and even unboxed the fruit trees that arrived. We recommend Coy's Tree Service. Great job at a fair price.

reviews.author: regis tivnan
reviews.text: I had a large dead pine tree, and before I knew it, it was gone! Coy Tree Service worked quickly and efficiently, no trace of workers, equipment, trucks, or debris left behind. Their service was fast, and the price was very reasonable. This is the way to go.

reviews.author: Brandon Collier
reviews.text: Coy’s is down right the best. Mr. Coy and his group of arborists did an amazing job tacking a mass of trees from my property. I am very pleased and will be working with them for any removal I have in the future.

reviews.author: Anne Lanteri
reviews.text: Highly recommend Jeremy and his crew. They did an excellent job and are very knowledgeable about trees.

reviews.author: David Rathbun
reviews.text: I used Coy's tree service to remove a large dead pine tree that had broken and was about to fall on my house. Jeramy and his crew responded quickly and rearrange their schedule to remove the tree right away due to the danger it presented. They very skillfully rigged ropes and pulley to gently lower the tree without damaging the house or surrounding trees. In addition to that operation they removed two other trees and trimmed multiple other trees and throughly cleaned up. I was very impressed with the quality of their work and highly recommend they for any tree or landscaping needs. Their prices are very reasonable and they are a first class company.

reviews.author: Nancy Ng
reviews.text: We highly recommend Coy’s Tree Service. The owner and crew showed up on time. They climbed and trimmed a number of trees around our home. Mr. Coy has experience and knowledge concerning the health of trees. He was on site during the entire process. All of our trees now look so much better.

reviews.author: Alex Bauld
reviews.text: We’ve had Mr.Coy and crew out to our property in Smyrna many times for tree trimming and handyman jobs, and without fail, he always goes above and beyond what we’ve expected. If you're looking for good, honest “local” work, Mr. Coy is your man.

reviews.author: Annie Tankard
reviews.text: I had some hedges that got out of control , that got to big to maintain, but they came and did a great job on trimming my hedges , and I would definitely use this company again, they did exactly the way I asked them to trim my hedges. I would 100% recommend the company. Thank you for recommending your son-in-law to me. Thank you, Annie Tankard.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Campbell
reviews.text: Jeremy Coy is a very honest hardworking man. He knows the struggles people have and he has had in his life and will not let anyone go through the same as he did!! He will be as fair and affordable as he possibly can and will give you 110% with all work he does. If you are looking for reasonable price, hard working, and trustworthy company he’s the guy to hire

reviews.author: Brenda Bright
reviews.text: I needed someone to do several jobs for me and Coy's did all of them. They cleared cleared off side of ditch, cut back overgrown shrubs. and hauled off trash from back and side of house. They are dependable, friendly, and reasonably priced. My property hasn't looked this great in years!

reviews.author: The Chelsea
reviews.text: Coy’s came out and quoted, set a date, and was very prompt and did exactly what we agreed upon. He and his team are friendly, hardworking and got the job done right! They worked within my budget and went above and beyond. If you’re needing work done, go with Coy’s! I’ll definitely be using their services again.

reviews.author: Joy Coombs
reviews.text: Im a widow with limited income and and a large tree limb that was dead and feared would fall on my bedroom during a hurricane! I told him. The price quoted was 1/4 what others wanted. They arrived within a week and had it done and cleared with in an hour. I am so greatful! I wrote that a year ago, and used them again today June 2024, they surprised me and instead of giving me an estimate, just went ahead and did the job! On the spot! I felt so blessed and have never been more pleased. The men are clean cut, kind, hard working and need no supervision. Rare these days. They cleaned up and were done within an hour. THANK YOU!

reviews.author: Cortney Springsted
reviews.text: These are great guys! Honest, hardworking and did an excellent job. I will call them again when needed, I highly recommend. May God bless!

reviews.author: Erika Spring
reviews.text: Coy and his team don’t play! They were right on time and took down about 10 trees, cleaned up everything and were pulling out of here in a couple hours! Super friendly and professional they left my property better than when they found it! Coy knows his stuff! Highly recommend

reviews.author: C Adams
reviews.text: Above and beyond, family business. Professional. On time. Fairly priced. Don't hesitate - call for an estimate. (Half day work done March 2025).

reviews.author: Joey Eubanks
reviews.text: I had a few stumps that needed to be ground. James Lowe came and did an excellent job at a reasonable price. Even volunteered to grind a few spots at no extra cost. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: tracy mcnemar
reviews.text: Thank goodness for Jeremy and his company!! I called him right after the last hurricane, l had a tree one my shed that had all of my bakery equipment in it. He went right over to make sure that th he shop was safe!! I was still out of town was going by my neighbors word on my trees being down. After my return he came and cut down my pecan tree due to the fact that it was not able to be put back up safely, he did look into it due to it being that kind of tree. He then went out front and cut down the trees that needed it at a price that l felt was so fair because I didn't have insurance to cover trees!! My homeowners policy didnt cover them... thank you so much for all your help!!

reviews.author: Andy Mullins
reviews.text: I used them on two occasions in the last couple of months to remove a tree and trim others. They were on time, courteous and did fantastic work at a great price. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Lawrence Dickinson
reviews.text: Coy performed the felling of 3 large pine trees and the cleanup of all debris. Work was excellent , professional. Hope to have Coy return and remove more trees on the property.

reviews.author: Ed S
reviews.text: I highly recommend Coy's Tree Service. The service was excellent. They had had the trees cut, loaded and cleaned up the debri from six tall pines in just a few hours. It looks great!

reviews.author: Tony Smith
reviews.text: An amazing company. A great work ethic! They got the job done quickly. A wonderful Christian family owned business. We will be calling them again soon!

reviews.author: Ryan Jones
reviews.text: Coy’s came out quickly to give an estimate after a storm knocked a couple trees down, and came on short notice the day after I agreed to their services. The job was quality and fast. Thanks!

reviews.author: Don Anson
reviews.text: Coy's did a fantastic job pruning and taking care of 100+ yr old live oaks. The team is courteous, professional, on-time, and reasonably priced. Thank you!

reviews.author: Janice Page
reviews.text: Holy shit these guys are awesome!!! Showed up and cleaned up and did absolutely stellar job!!!! Will hire again!!! Thank you so much!!! Looks Phenominal!!

reviews.author: Haley Peaden
reviews.text: Very professional and great quality. Was here when he said they would be, took down 2 huge trees, that were right beside a shop, with no problem! And cleaned everything up! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Mary Sherwood
reviews.text: Extremely professional! Hardworking! Excellent job! Arrived early, finished quickly. Cleaned up awesome! I highly recommend! Exceptional value! Christian Company!

reviews.author: Carol Robinette
reviews.text: I've had several tree services but these guys were the best. Reasonably priced and quality work. Will recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: newman brown
reviews.text: Jeremy Coy is as honest as they come. I don't put my name behind many things, but if you need work done, you won't find anyone better than Coys tree service.

reviews.author: J Smith
reviews.text: This company is top notch. They did a wonderful safe job on a dangerous tree. 100% satisfaction all around.

reviews.author: Tom A
reviews.text: Fantastic company!! Owner provides great prices and work, reliable and can always expect the best from these guys. 10/10 would use them for anything!

reviews.author: matt brown
reviews.text: Coy and his folks did a great job for me. Showed up on time, cleaned up. Could not have asked for better job.

reviews.author: Mark Mosley
reviews.text: Great group of people. They arrived alittle early, Worked until the trees where removed, then cleaned up the mess. I would use them again without a problem.

reviews.author: Stephen Beattie
reviews.text: Hired via recommendation through a friend, they were punctual professional and I was pleased with the experience.

reviews.author: gonz94
reviews.text: Very professional and reasonable. Communication was on point and timely. Will be sharing with others and will use again!

reviews.author: Robert Smith
reviews.text: The guys showed up this morning right on time. Did a great job cleaned up behind theirselves. I would recommend these guys anytime.

reviews.author: carroll greene
reviews.text: We had a big limb hit our house during a storm. Coy's team was there quickly and made short safe work of the mess. Professional, detail focused and did a GREAT job! We recommend them highly! CG
